content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a personal to-do list","i_want":"to view my task list with a status and a priority indicator on each task","so_that":"I can see the state and urgency of all my tasks on one page","business_description":"The to-do management page shows the signed-in user's own tasks. Each row shows the task's status (Open, In Progress or Completed) and priority (Low, Medium or High) as text plus a visually distinct mark. The page shows distinct loading, empty and error states, and reloads the list from the backend after a successful task change. The backend provides read endpoints for all tasks and for one task by ID, and returns only the requesting user's tasks.","business_value":"Users can see the status and priority of all their tasks at a glance, and the list always reflects what the backend has saved, so no change is shown as successful before the backend confirms it.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The user has at least one task in their personal task list","when":"The user opens the to-do management page","then":"The task list view shows each of the user's tasks, with a status indicator and a priority indicator on every row"},{"given":"A task has status Open, In Progress or Completed","when":"The task list view renders that task","then":"The status indicator shows the task's current status text and a visually distinct mark for each of the three values"},{"given":"A task has priority Low, Medium or High","when":"The task list view renders that task","then":"The priority indicator shows the task's priority text and a visually distinct mark for each of the three values"},{"given":"The task list request to the backend has not yet completed","when":"The task list view is displayed","then":"A loading state is shown and no task rows or empty-state text are shown"},{"given":"The user has no tasks","when":"The backend returns an empty task list","then":"The empty state is shown and no task rows are shown"},{"given":"The task list request to the backend fails with an error","when":"The task list view is displayed","then":"The error state is shown with a message, and the loading state is no longer shown"},{"given":"The backend returns an internal server or database error for the task list request","when":"The task list view receives the error response","then":"The error state is shown and no task rows or empty-state text are shown"},{"given":"The task list is displayed and the user creates, updates, deletes or changes the status of a task","when":"The backend confirms the change succeeded","then":"The task list is reloaded from the backend and shows the changed task without a manual page refresh"},{"given":"The task list is displayed and the user creates, updates, deletes or changes the status of a task","when":"The backend request for the change fails","then":"The task list does not show the change as applied and the list is not reloaded as if the change succeeded"},{"given":"The backend read endpoint for all tasks is called by a user with tasks","when":"The request is received","then":"The backend returns only the tasks belonging to the requesting user"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist is requested","when":"The backend read-by-ID endpoint GET /tasks/{id} is called","then":"The backend returns a task-not-found error and no task data"}],"edge_cases":["A user with no tasks sees the empty state, not an error","A task ID that does not exist (for example, a task deleted earlier) returns a task-not-found error from GET /tasks/{id}","The PRD does not state the order of tasks in the list; the default order is an open question","The PRD does not state how many tasks the list shows per page or whether it paginates; this is an open question","If the change succeeds in the backend but the follow-up reload fails, the PRD does not state what the list shows; this is an open question","Status and priority values are limited to Open, In Progress, Completed and Low, Medium, High; any other stored value is not defined by the PRD"],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["GET /tasks returns only the errors","Task list view shows status and priority indicators for every row, with a text label and a distinct mark for each allowed value","Loading, empty and error states are each shown and tested","List reloads from the backend only after a successful change, and never shows a change before the backend confirms it","Test suite covers the list view states, indicators, refresh behaviour and read endpoints, and passes in CI"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"tasks-read-endpoints","title":"[BE] Add GET /tasks and GET /tasks/{id} read endpoints with not-found
